name: Continuous exercise advice
description: One locked gym take of a repeated exercise with synchronized equipment motion and a persistent instructional caption.
lockedGrammar: Approximately three concentric and eccentric phases
Hands, machine arms, cable and weight stack move causally together

variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional adult exerciser with a consistent face and body

variables.description: Machine exercise and causal equipment path.

examples: If your chest isn't growing, try starting with flies...

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Create {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation seated at a {{exercise}} machine in an ordinary commercial gym, wearing {{wardrobe}}, arms at the correct opening position under flat overhead light.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform about three controlled {{exercise}} inward phases and eccentric returns over seven seconds at natural real-time cadence. Hands, handles, machine arms, cable and weight stack must move together causally. Keep {{subject_identity}} and the locked camera stable.

deterministicLayers.template: Render this exact persistent centered six-line caption: {{caption_text}}
Use {{audio_policy}} without changing the motion timing.

promptExamples: Use the continuous exercise advice format with a woman doing pec fly and my chest-training caption.

notes: One setup edit plus one video generation reproduced the continuous take and zero-cut structure.
Minor hand/handle smoothing and cable-area texture flicker remain.
